name: Actuator Night Shift
description: A robotics lab's actuator console has gone quiet during the night shift. On the lab network, scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199. Find the protected console record and recover its flag.

tasks.name: Recover the actuator record
tasks.description: The robotics lab's actuator console is reachable on the lab network. Scan 172.20.0.0/24, where challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199, and recover the flag from the protected console record.
hints: Compare the reachable lab services and look for operational material that belongs to the night shift.
A credential exposed by one service may also grant access to another service. Identify what kind of service is holding the protected record.
Authenticate to the Redis service with the discovered password, then read the actuator record.
